subject: Sponsorship request: shielded Private VPC evaluation for Helion Health
messages:
From: Claire Rodriguez <claire@helionhealth.com>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Tom Brenner <tbrenner@helionhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 09 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sponsorship request: Private VPC evaluation for Helion Health

Hi Mateo,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — Helion's infrastructure and security team liked the performance notes, but we've hit a compliance gating item on our side. Our procurement and InfoSec leads require that any POC running on private/VPC must either run in a customer-managed VPC or be covered by an evaluation sponsorship that includes isolated billing and audit logs for 30 days.

Two asks from our end:
- Can Redwood sponsor a set of evaluation credits to cover a 30-day Private VPC proof-of-concept (we estimate ~5k credit units based on the runbook)?
- We also need a redacted SOC2 evidence packet and a short network diagram showing how Redwood's private deployment would handle log isolation for Helion.

I've attached our Security Questionnaire (redacted) for reference. Procurement is asking for the sponsorship paperwork and an estimated timeline by EOD Monday so we can circle back to legal.

Appreciate any help — cc'ing Tom (IT Ops) and security@ so they can chime in on the technical constraints.

Best,
Claire
Claire Rodriguez
Head of Platform Partnerships
Helion Health

Attachments: Helion_Security_Questionnaire.pdf (pdf)

Hi Claire — thanks for the clear summary and the questionnaire.

Quick answers up front: we can usually support a sponsored evaluation for Private VPCs, but approvals hinge on (1) the level of audit/log access required and (2) legal/finance confirmation on credits. To move quickly, can you confirm the target workload (chat+embeddings throughput) and whether Helion needs an on-prem install or a VPC-in-cloud with customer-managed subnets? That will change the estimate.

Laura — can you confirm what we can share now (redacted SOC2) and whether the network diagram below will map to our private deployment option?

I'll loop in AE (Priyom) to start the approval and funding ask. If we can get the procurement language today I can escalate to revenue ops for an expedited credits allocation.

Thanks,

Hi all — looping in technical details.

We can provide a redacted SOC2 summary and the following as attachments: redacted SOC2 evidence bundle (high level), an architecture sketch for a VPC-isolated deployment, and sample audit log retention policies. The items we would need from Helion to scope the environment:
- expected peak concurrent sessions and average prompt length (tokens)
- whether the KV cache needs to be persisted between restarts
- RPO/RTO expectations for the 30-day POC

From a networking standpoint: our Private option can be deployed into a customer-managed VPC using VPC Peering or PrivateLink. For stricter requirements we offer a packaged on-prem appliance (air-gapped) that we can discuss, but that moves beyond a simple credits sponsorship.

I've attached: mvp_vpc_network_diagram.png (PNG), SOC2_report_redacted.pdf (pdf).

If Helion confirms the throughput estimate (even a rough number) we can firm up the credit quantity; 5k was a reasonable ballpark.

Thanks,

Subject: Approved: Helion 30-day shielded eval sponsorship (conditional)

Claire / Tom — good news. Revenue Ops has approved a conditional sponsorship. Summary of final terms (approved today):

- Sponsored credits: 5,000 units allocated to Helion for a 30-day Private/VPC evaluation.
- Extension: 30 days from provisioning date; one-time extension possible pending evidence of active testing.
- Conditions: Provide redacted SOC2 evidence and confirm the expected throughput (peak concurrent sessions and avg tokens). We must receive the SOC2 redacted packet before we provision the environment.
- Deliverables from Redwood: redacted SOC2 summary, network diagram (attached), and a short POC addendum to the standard trial terms.

Next steps:
1) Claire — please upload the expected throughput numbers and confirm whether you want VPC Peering or PrivateLink to the contact in our POC guide.
2) Once we receive the SOC2 redacted packet, Revenue Ops will provision the credits and send a provisioning email with the tenant ID and instructions.
3) Priyom will send the POC addendum for signatures via DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/signer/abc123

Attachments included: SOC2_report_redacted.pdf, mvp_vpc_network_diagram.png

If you need the sponsorship faster for procurement, I can request an expedited provisioning window (24–48 hrs) once legal confirms the addendum.
